name: RC-B10-0419/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action after Russian drones and fighter jets entered the airspace of Poland, Estonia, Lithuania and Romania, and drones flew near airports in Denmark, Sweden and Norway. It asks the European Union and its member states to act together: shoot down threats, build a drone-proof eastern border, spend more on defence, and keep supporting Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a request for joint air defence, a "drone wall" and more defence spending.
- **Who it affects:** EU member states, especially those on the eastern flank, plus Ukraine and NATO.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to present a plan at the 23–24 October 2025 summit.
